title: Recent Block Use and the TimeBank Extension Fee
content:
Extension recent-use schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: when the hours drawn on the block in the three months counted back from signing, meaning draws dated after the same day three months earlier, reach at least 0.25 of its hours purchased, the fee is multiplied by 0.8; when they reach at least 0.10 and less than 0.25, by 0.9; otherwise by 1. The hours counted are the hours of the block's draws in that window, as its hours ledger shows them.

| Hours drawn in the three months, share of hours purchased | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0.25 (25 percent) or more | 0.8 |
| 0.10 (10 percent) or more, below 0.25 | 0.9 |
| below 0.10 | 1 |

Hypothetical cases on an 80-hour block signed on 20 August: draws dated 21 May onward count and a draw dated 20 May does not; 20.00 hours drawn in the window is 0.25 and gives 0.8; 19.99 hours gives 0.9; 7.99 hours gives 1.
